summary.text: Finger Wind Dragon is Wu Yong's immortal killer move. A dark jade worm flies from his fingertip and grows into a vicious wind dragon.

claims.text: From the second floor window of Clear Jade Dripping Wind Tiny Bamboo Building, Wu Yong flicks his index finger at Fang Yuan and activates the immortal killer move Finger Wind Dragon. Mid-flight the cast swells through ten, fifty, and a hundred and fifty feet, and after a few breaths it is two hundred and twenty feet long as it drives at the upper extreme heavenly eagle. Fang Yuan steps into the collision on purpose; under reverse flow protection seal it deals him no damage, turns back on Wu Yong, smashes into the Immortal Gu House so hard the house’s speed falls by more than half, and then crumbles.

Against Feng Jiu Ge the same cast is named Wu Yong’s specialty immortal killer move. Its core is a rank eight Immortal Gu, so Feng Jiu Ge cannot meet it with killer moves that use rank seven Immortal Gu as cores; he retreats and spends rank seven red date immortal essence to weaken the dragon until it dissipates. One finger wind dragon breaks their stalemate and suppresses him. Wu Yong has stacked chaotic shooting blades on it: if that follow-up activates, the dragon self-detonates into countless jade wind blades that shoot everywhere, a method that already showed its might in the purple blood river formation. The dragon is extremely fast; with six soft vajra wind chiefs also pressing him, Feng Jiu Ge cannot interrupt Wu Yong’s next preparation until Fang Yuan takes the collision and reverse flow protection seal sends the dragon flying back at Wu Yong.

On Heavenly Court’s battlefield Wu Yong activates Finger Wind Dragon again and is forced back into Clear Jade Dripping Wind Tiny Bamboo Building by the joint attack of three Heavenly Court members, which stops his push toward Heaven Overseeing Tower.

He later flicks out several dark jade worms that grow into the same two-hundred-and-twenty-foot wind dragons, then with chaotic shooting blades turns them into jade wind blades that cut into Heavenly Court’s defensive line so he can try to infiltrate; Wan Zi Hong blocks that attempt.
